dialogues.speaker: Flight Master
dialogues.text: I say, this is indeed a Nightwatch Contract penned by our Prinzessin...

dialogues.speaker: Flight Master
dialogues.text: Well! I know not how Her Highness gave you leave, but it seems you are a figure of some standing at least. Still, I caution you that this route is most perilous.

dialogues.speaker: Flight Master
dialogues.text: I recommend you reconsider. When you are truly ready and willing to recant any doubt or concern and resolutely travel upon this route, then seek me again.
